episodes.title: A Man Holding Flowers
episodes.summary: An Joon Ho's keen eye earns him a position in the Deserter Pursuit unit. On his first mission with Park Sung Woo, things don't go quite as planned.

episodes.title: Daydream
episodes.summary: Discharged from the hospital, Han Ho Yul returns to the base and partners up with Joon Ho to search for a soldier last spotted at a subway station.

episodes.title: That Woman
episodes.summary: Joon Ho and Ho Yul assist with a mission while on break. In an attempt to gain intel, the two go undercover to befriend a deserter's girlfriend.

episodes.title: The Monty Hall Problem
episodes.summary: Relentless hazing shifts Jo Suk Bong's once-warm personality. Riddled with responsibilities, an enlistee jumps the fence at the dead of night.

episodes.title: Military Dog
episodes.summary: Suk Bong is pushed over the edge. During their investigation, the D.P. duo learns of events that unfolded at Hwang Jang Soo's discharge.

episodes.title: Onlookers
episodes.summary: When a chase after a deserter turns into a manhunt for a criminal at large, Joon Ho and Ho Yul rush to find him before armed men bring him down.

episodes.title: The Rains
episodes.summary: Jun-ho navigates his life post-tragedy. Park Beom-gu feels pressure to cover up recent events. A sudden attack shocks the military.

episodes.title: Dirty Play
episodes.summary: While Kim Ru-ri goes public with his motive, Seo Eun sets up a lure to catch him. Jun-ho and Ho-yeol attempt to stop the growing escalation.

episodes.title: Curtain Call
episodes.summary: Jun-ho and Ho-yeol receive unexpected praise from the military. They later set off to catch a deserter who was bullied relentlessly for being different.

episodes.title: The Charred Remains
episodes.summary: Lim Ji-seop and Beom-gu realize that an investigation into a military death isn't as it seems. The government faces a damning accusation.

episodes.title: An Jun-ho
episodes.summary: Jun-ho discovers the extent of the military's secrets — making a critical decision. Oh Min-u pursues crucial evidence to stop it from being released.

episodes.title: The Day
episodes.summary: Ho-yeol makes a deal to help Jun-ho, who faces harsh consequences. In a fight for justice, the trial against the government takes a surprising turn.
